leftEvidence.role: The mission and the divided report
leftEvidence.title: Ten men deny Israel’s ability and spread an evil report

points.label: Event action and claim
points.left: The other men say Israel cannot go up because the inhabitants are stronger, and they spread an evil report about the land.
points.right: Joshua secretly sends two men to Jericho; Rahab hides them and declares that the land’s inhabitants have heard what the LORD did and are melting in fear.

points.label: Response and consequence
points.left: They describe a land that eats its inhabitants, unusually tall people, Nephilim, and themselves as grasshoppers.
points.right: The men return saying the LORD has delivered the land and all inhabitants melt before Israel.

payload.posture: Both missions inspect the land and return with a report about inhabitants and Israel’s prospects.

rightEvidence.role: Another spying mission and the delayed inheritance
rightEvidence.title: Two spies return from Jericho with a different report

payload.tension: The twelve divide over entry; Joshua’s two hear fear inside Jericho and report that the LORD has delivered the land.
payload.title: Twelve spies and two spies
